== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Kitik Keed'kak (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_15</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 15), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-15-Kitik_Keed_kak.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-kitikkeedkak-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Kitik Keed'kak (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “During battle, may add 1 to your attrition against opponent for each opponent's character present. May not deploy to or board starfighters or enclosed vehicles.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), STANDARD rev 71: the card's own Virtual Legacy card (same Decipher art, frame, lore, icons, slip number and Virtual Block 1 set mark as the printed card) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
